data.value: No contacts received. Is “Sync Contacts” turned on on your iPhone?

data.name: Phone_Messages_Empty
data.value: No messages yet. SMS and iMessage messages you receive while your iPhone is connected appear here.

data.name: Phone_Calls_FixHeader
data.value: To get call audio on this PC

data.name: Phone_Call_AncsNote
data.value: The call continues on your iPhone. This PC can only answer or decline.

data.name: Phone_Cap_Ready
data.value: The Windows hands-free link is ready: take calls with this PC’s speakers and microphone.

data.name: Phone_Cap_NoPackage
data.value: NitroDrop is running without a package, and Windows gives call audio only to apps with a package identity.

data.name: Phone_Cap_LineError
data.value: Couldn’t open the Windows phone line ({0}).

data.name: Phone_Cap_NoHandsFree
data.value: Windows doesn’t list the iPhone as a hands-free (HFP) device.

data.name: Phone_Cap_DeniedBySystem
data.value: This iPhone’s calls are registered to another app (most likely Phone Link).

data.name: Phone_Cap_DeniedByUser
data.value: Access to phone calls wasn’t allowed.

data.name: Phone_Cap_NotRegistered
data.value: Windows didn’t accept the app registration (RegisterApp).

data.name: Phone_Cap_ConnectFailed
data.value: Windows couldn’t set up the hands-free link (ConnectAsync).

data.name: Phone_Cap_SuffixControlOnly
data.value: You can still answer or decline calls here; the conversation stays on your iPhone.

data.name: Phone_Cap_SuffixNoAncs
data.value: The notification link (ANCS) isn’t available either.

data.name: Phone_Fix_Package
data.value: Install NitroDrop from its MSIX package. Windows needs the package to hand call audio to the app.

data.name: Phone_Fix_PhoneLink
data.value: Remove this iPhone in Phone Link, then remove it from Windows Bluetooth settings and pair it again with NitroDrop.

data.name: Phone_Fix_HandsFree
data.value: Pair the iPhone in Windows Bluetooth settings and allow “Sync Contacts” during pairing.

data.name: Phone_Fix_Privacy
data.value: Allow NitroDrop in Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Phone calls.

data.name: Phone_Fix_Nearby
data.value: Make sure the iPhone is nearby with Bluetooth turned on.
